verdict.rationale: Zero is described by its founder as an AI email client that lets users chat with their inbox, summarize threads and draft replies, and its docs list AI-assisted composing and asking questions about mailbox content and specific threads. An official MCP server exposes actions such as send, draft, delete, bulk archive, label and search, so an external agent can carry out natural-language requests. Missing for 10: documentation that in-app chat can execute mailbox actions (not just answer questions or draft), independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and OAuth for MCP connection (still 'coming soon').
